texts.orig: As  shown  in FIGS. 4  and  5, the pet display  belt 21  is of  Somewhat  Similar construction to the lower  or  waist  Section  of  the Vest as  upper  and  lower  annular, tubular, passageway  portions 23 and 24 joined along their entire  lengths,  as  indicated  schematically  by  the broken  lines in FIG.  4  and  5,  and are integral with annular waist band forming  Strip 22,  (also of heat Sealable plastic), with the lower passageway  portion  24  being  attached  to respective pocket-form animal  receiving chambers  3' also attached to the waist band, and  communicating with each other via a port 16'. Adjustable  fastening members 26 of intermeshing multiple hook and  eye type fabrics are provided  on  opposite ends  of  the waist  band  to secure the display belt about the waist of  a  wearer.  When the belt is not worn it  may  be supported by a flat  Surface  to  provide  a  permanent home for  the  pets,  as  illustrated in FIG. 5.
